# CWE-250: Execution with Unnecessary Privileges — Detection in IaC Scripts

## Overview of Detectable Weaknesses

---

### 1. **Running Workloads as Root or Privileged User**

The most direct indicator of this weakness in IaC.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| User identity | `user`, `runAsUser`, `run_as_user`, `USER` |
| Root indicators | `root`, `0` (UID 0), `"root"` as username |
| Root flags | `runAsRoot`, `run_as_root`, `is_root` |
| Non-root enforcement absence | Missing `runAsNonRoot: true` or `run_as_non_root` |

---

### 2. **Privileged Container or Process Mode**

Granting a workload near-full kernel access.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Privileged flag | `privileged`, `privileged_mode` |
| Dangerous values | `privileged: true`, `privileged_mode: true` |
| Absence of restriction | No `securityContext` block defined at all |

---

### 3. **Excessive Linux Capabilities**

Adding capabilities beyond operational necessity.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Capability addition | `cap_add`, `add`, `capabilities` |
| Dangerous values | `ALL`, `SYS_ADMIN`, `NET_ADMIN`, `SYS_PTRACE`, `SYS_MODULE`, `DAC_OVERRIDE`, `DAC_READ_SEARCH`, `SETUID`, `SETGID`, `FSETID` |
| Absence of drop | Missing `cap_drop`, `drop` block, or `drop: ["ALL"]` |

---

### 4. **Allowance of Privilege Escalation**

Permitting processes to gain more privileges than their parent.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Escalation flag | `allowPrivilegeEscalation`, `allow_privilege_escalation` |
| Dangerous values | `allowPrivilegeEscalation: true` (or omission, which defaults to true in many runtimes) |

---

### 5. **Wildcard or Overly Broad IAM / Permission Policies**

Granting more access than necessary through identity and access configurations.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Action wildcards | `Action`, `actions`, `effect`, `permissions` |
| Dangerous values | `"*"`, `"Action": "*"`, `"Resource": "*"` |
| Predefined over-privileged roles | `AdministratorAccess`, `FullAccess`, `PowerUser`, `Owner`, `Contributor` |
| Effect | `Allow` combined with wildcard resources/actions |

---

### 6. **Unnecessary Host Namespace Sharing**

Sharing host-level namespaces removes isolation and grants broader privileges.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| PID namespace | `hostPID`, `host_pid` — dangerous when `true` |
| IPC namespace | `hostIPC`, `host_ipc` — dangerous when `true` |
| Network namespace | `hostNetwork`, `host_network` — dangerous when `true` |
| User namespace | `userns_mode: host`, `user_ns_mode` |

---

### 7. **Unconfined or Permissive Security Profiles**

Absence or weakening of mandatory access control profiles.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| AppArmor profile | `apparmor`, `appArmorProfile`, `type: Unconfined` |
| Seccomp profile | `seccompProfile`, `seccomp.security.alpha`, `type: Unconfined` |
| SELinux options | `seLinuxOptions`, `type: spc_t` |
| Dangerous values | `Unconfined`, `unconfined`, `disable`, `""`  |

---

### 8. **Overly Permissive Role or Policy Bindings**

Binding identities to administrative or cluster-wide roles.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Role binding scope | `ClusterRoleBinding`, `cluster_role_binding`, `RoleBinding` |
| Dangerous role references | `cluster-admin`, `system:masters`, `admin`, `edit` |
| Principal wildcards | `subjects: system:authenticated`, `system:unauthenticated` |

---

### 9. **Writable Root Filesystem**

Allows processes to modify system files, amplifying damage from privilege abuse.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Read-only flag | `readOnlyRootFilesystem`, `read_only_root_filesystem`, `readOnlyFs` |
| Dangerous value | `false` or absent (defaults to writable in most runtimes) |

---

### 10. **Mounting Sensitive Host Paths**

Granting access to host-level directories effectively elevates container privileges.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Volume type | `hostPath`, `host_path`, `volume_type` |
| Sensitive paths | `/`, `/etc`, `/proc`, `/sys`, `/var/run`, `/run`, `/dev`, `/root`, `/home` |
| Docker socket | `/var/run/docker.sock`, `/run/docker.sock` |

---

### 11. **Setuid/Setgid Bits on Executables**

Allows binaries to run with elevated owner privileges regardless of who executes them.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Permission mode | `mode`, `chmod`, `file_mode`, `permissions` |
| Dangerous values | `4755`, `6755`, `0777`, `s` bit in octal notation, `SUID`, `SGID`, `setuid`, `setgid` |

---

### 12. **Unrestricted Sudo or Superuser Access**

Granting broad administrative shell-level privileges via provisioning scripts.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Sudo configuration | `sudo`, `sudoers`, `visudo`, `NOPASSWD` |
| Dangerous patterns | `ALL=(ALL) ALL`, `ALL=(ALL:ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL`, `wheel` group membership without restriction |

---

### 13. **Overly Permissive Storage/Bucket Policies**

Storage resources configured with write or admin access beyond requirement.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Access control | `acl`, `access_control`, `bucket_policy`, `public_access` |
| Dangerous values | `public-read-write`, `authenticated-read`, `BucketOwnerFullControl`, `"Principal": "*"` |

---

### 14. **Service Account Token Auto-Mounting**

Automatically mounts credentials that may grant unneeded API access.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Token mount flag | `automountServiceAccountToken`, `automount_service_account_token` |
| Dangerous value | `true` or absent when a default service account with broad rights is used |

---

## Summary Table of Key Keywords

| Category | Critical Keywords / Values |
|---|---|
| User Identity | `root`, `0`, `runAsUser: 0`, `USER root` |
| Privileged Mode | `privileged: true` |
| Capabilities | `cap_add: ALL`, `SYS_ADMIN`, `NET_ADMIN` |
| Escalation | `allowPrivilegeEscalation: true` |
| IAM Permissions | `"*"`, `AdministratorAccess`, `Action: "*"`, `Resource: "*"` |
| Host Namespaces | `hostPID: true`, `hostIPC: true`, `hostNetwork: true` |
| Security Profiles | `Unconfined`, `seccompProfile: Unconfined` |
| Role Bindings | `cluster-admin`, `system:masters` |
| Filesystem | `readOnlyRootFilesystem: false`, `/var/run/docker.sock` |
| File Permissions | `chmod 777`, `4755`, `SUID`, `SGID` |
| Sudo | `NOPASSWD`, `ALL=(ALL) ALL` |
| Storage ACL | `public-read-write`, `"Principal": "*"` |

package glitch

import data.glitch_lib

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.name == {"privileged", "privileged_mode"}[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "Boolean"
    attr.value.value == true
    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Container running in privileged mode. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

    result := {

        "element": attr,

    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {

    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match("/var/run/docker\\.sock|/run/docker\\.sock", attr.value.value)
    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Docker socket mounted, granting host-level docker access. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    regex.match("(?i)(apparmor|seccomp)", attr.name)
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match("(?i)^(unconfined|disable)$", attr.value.value)
    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Unconfined or disabled security profile configured. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    regex.match("(?i)(sudo|sudoers)", attr.name)
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match("NOPASSWD|ALL=\\(ALL", attr.value.value)
    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Overly permissive sudo configuration found. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    regex.match("(?i)^(action|actions|resource|resources|permissions|principal)$", attr.name)
    glitch_lib.traverse(attr.value, "^[*]$")
    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Wildcard permission grants excessive access. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    regex.match("(?i)(role|policy|permission)", attr.name)
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match("(?i)(AdministratorAccess|FullAccess|PowerUser|cluster-admin|system:masters)", attr.value.value)
    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Overly privileged role or policy assigned. (CWE-250)"
    }
}
